theorems.name: Submission.simon_chart_range_fderiv_le_tangentSpace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → MapsTo ψ V M → ∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap ≤ tangentSpace M (ψ x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
